question: **Select the MISSPELT word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is **'Embroidary.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• 
 Out of all the options, the word **'Embroidary'** is wrong.
 
 
• 
 The correct spelling is **'Embroidery'**.
 
 
• 
 The **meaning** of 'Embroidery' is 'decorating a cloth with patterns or pictures sewn directly onto the material'. (*सामग्री पर सीधे सिलने वाले पैटर्न या चित्रों के साथ एक कपड़े को सजाना।)*

 
 
• 
 **For example**, *Yarn and an embroidery needle were used to make a cozy blanket for the newborn.*
 
 
 
 
• 
 Therefore, the correct option is **3**.
